title: Your Home screen (mobile)
lead: Home is the daily desk. Same data in every Experience Mode — only how much you see changes. Tap PX in the bottom bar to try Beginner, Standard, or Power User. No data loss.
pxHint: PX is beta presentation only. Your logs stay. Switch anytime.

modes.title: Beginner
modes.lead: Zero dashboard. Greeting, today’s health, a task list. Tap a row to log with Buddy.

items.label: Top bar
items.text: kCal Buddy, language, theme, and Settings.

items.label: Greeting
items.text: Buddy says hello. One line. That’s the whole coach.

items.label: Today’s Health
items.text: Calories, protein, fiber, water, drinks, and your burn vs goal. Tap a row for details.

items.label: Daily task list
items.text: Breakfast · Lunch · Dinner · Snack · Drinks · Water. Tap a box → Buddy. It checks off only after you save.

items.label: Bottom tabs
items.text: Home · Foodiary · Progress · PX Beg · Menu. No Meal Plan, Activity, or Spaces here.

modes.title: Standard
modes.lead: Buddy is the host. Today’s Progress is the compass. Health cards sit under the budget.
modes.nav: Home · Meal Plan · Foodiary · Activity · Progress · Spaces · Menu

items.label: Buddy host
items.text: Larger Buddy and a short greeting. Language, theme, and Settings stay on the right.

items.label: Toolbox
items.text: Camera is the orange hero. Water, Weight, and Cart stay quiet (white chips, colored icons). Cart is last. Dashboard cards keep the strong colors.

items.label: More
items.text: Camera’s chevron: Camera, Photo, Receipt / File, Text input, Voice — A–Z. Text is how you type a meal.

items.label: Today clock
items.text: Date, time, sun timeline, weather. Context — not a log.

items.label: Today’s Progress
items.text: Daily energy budget: Food · Exercise · Remaining. No TEF in Standard.

items.label: Health cards
items.text: Protein · Fiber · Water · Drinks. Tap a card for details.

items.label: Bottom tabs
items.text: Home plus Meal Plan, Foodiary, Activity, Progress, Spaces, PX Std, Menu.

modes.title: Power User
modes.lead: Same Home as Standard, with TEF and leucine on the budget and protein card.
modes.nav: Same tabs as Standard · desktop can add Reports · Insights · Goals

items.label: Buddy host
items.text: Same toolbox as Standard: Camera · Water · Weight · Cart.

items.label: Energy budget + TEF
items.text: Food · TEF · Exercise · Remaining. TEF is the extra burn from eating — not a second meal.

items.label: Protein + leucine
items.text: Protein card shows a leucine estimate. Fiber, water, drinks stay as in Standard.

items.label: Everything else
items.text: Clock, tip, mission, Spaces glance — richer detail, same jobs. PX Pwr in the bottom bar.
